blocks.arabic_text: جِيرَانِهِمْ، وَيَتَّعِظُونَ، وَيَتَفَقَّهُونَ أَوْ لَأُعَاجِلَنَّهُمُ الْعُقُوبَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَقَالُوا: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! أَنُفَطِّنُ غَيْرَنَا، فَأَعَادَ قَوْلَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَعَادُوا قَوْلَهُمْ، أَنُفَطِّنُ غَيْرَنَا، فَقَالَ ذلِكَ أَيْضاً، فَقَالُوا: أَمْهِلْنَا سَنَةً، فَأَمْهَلَهُمْ سَنَةً لِيُفَقِّهُوهُمْ، وَيُعَلِّمُوهُمْ، وَيَعِظُوهُمْ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ هذِهِ اْلآيَةَ: (لُعِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ م بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلي لِسَانِ دَاؤُدَ وَعِيسَي بْنِ مَرْيَمَ۞) الآية.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبيرعن بكير بن معروف عن علقمة، الترغيب:١٢٢/١، بكيربن معروف صدوق فيه لين، تقريب التهذيب.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Alqamah ibn Sa'id (RA) narrates, “Once Rasulullah ﷺ gave a sermon and praised some groups among the Muslims. Then he said: “What has come over some people? Why do they neither impart understanding of the Din to the people living next to them, nor teach them the Din, nor advise them, nor enjoin good deeds upon them, nor stop them from evils? And what has come over some people? Why do they not learn the Din from those living near them, nor gain understanding of the Din, nor take advice? By Allah Ta'ala! These people must teach Ilm to those living near them, create understanding of the Din in them, give them advice, enjoin good deeds upon them and stop them from evils; and the other people must learn the Din from those living next to them, gain understanding of the Din from them and accept their advice. If they do not do so, I will punish all of them severely in this very world.” After this Rasulullah ﷺ came down from the minbar. “Which group was Rasulullah ﷺ speaking about?'
